audio_spectrum.label: Audio spectrum
audio_spectrum.description: Receive the audio spectrum; the desktop matrix needs it.

audio_spectrum_bands.label: Bands
audio_spectrum_bands.description: Number of frequency bands, one per matrix ring.

color.label: Dot color
color.description: Color role of the lit dots.

pitch.label: Grid step
pitch.description: Distance between two dot centers in pixels; sets the matrix size.

dot_scale.label: Dot size
dot_scale.description: Dot diameter relative to the grid step.

off_opacity.label: Unlit dots
off_opacity.description: Opacity of the dots that are off, like unlit LEDs; 0 hides them.

accent_color.label: Accent color
accent_color.description: Color role of the center dot, the marked dots and the playhead.

disc_size.label: Disc size
disc_size.description: Diameter of the dot disc in pixels.

dim_color.label: Secondary color
dim_color.description: Color role of every other ring and of the small text.
